extension.summary: Screensavers, apps and GPU add-ons by P-Hoep
extension.description: Installs and keeps up to date the P-Hoep screensavers and tools: God's Eye Map, God's World Map, Math Clock, Couchstronomy, SkyWatch, Live Cams, Word Clock, Sand Clock, Jeopkodi, OpenTrivia, DVD Logo, Tetris AI, Sheetcards and RSS Live Tiles (the last three each an app and a screensaver), the Screensaver Switcher and Audioshelf. It also publishes the native OpenGL add-ons: Tetris AI (OpenGL), Endless World (OpenGL), Growing Plant (OpenGL), Sand Clock (OpenGL), Liquid Clock, Cellular Automata (full, Lite and 3D), Physarum and Physarum Lite, and the Physarum music visualisation, each in the build for its platform. Kodi checks this repository for new versions and updates the add-ons automatically.
